prompt:
USE: A flat game decal for the face of a tower clock. Straight-on orthographic view, no perspective.
SUBJECT: A circular clock dial centred in a square frame, filling 92 percent of the width. A thin aged-brass rim. Inside it, a satin-brass dial with twelve plain raised bars for the hours, longer at the 12, 3, 6 and 9 positions, and a fine track of small minute bars. A small round brass boss at the centre. No hands: the hands are separate parts. No numerals and no letters.
STYLE: Photographic realism with restraint. Aged brass with soft warm tarnish, fine brushed grain and a few hairline scratches. Soft, even, shadowless light from all sides. No mirror reflections, no glow, so the colours read as base colour.
CONSTRAINTS: Fully transparent background outside the rim, with a crisp edge and no halo. Do not draw a checkerboard, a backdrop, a wall or a drop shadow. No text of any kind, no numerals. No logos, no watermarks. Original design only.
